families.title: Annual rooftop solar electricity
families.template: For a supplied installed-module surface area and climate region, estimate first-year annual AC electricity from a fixed rooftop photovoltaic installation.
families.estimand: First-year annual AC electricity delivered by a fixed roof-mounted commercial photovoltaic installation, normalized to the sum of installed module surface areas.
families.external_back_check: Use the CPUC/Itron metered commercial-system distribution as an old regional plausibility check and EIA as a correlated national aggregate check; neither establishes observed national ground truth or Class A status.
risks: capacity factor already incorporates system losses, so a separate performance ratio would double-count them
installed module surface area must not be confused with gross roof area, suitable roof area, or cell aperture area
orientation and residual operating shading may dominate
EIA estimated generation is partly NREL-modeled and is not independent ground truth
the CPUC/Itron comparison is old and California-specific and its capacity denominator requires human confirmation
human source and construct review and second-human adjudication remain required

families.title: Annual wind-farm electricity
families.template: For a supplied turbine count, rated capacity, and wind-resource class, estimate annual AC electricity from a wind project.
families.estimand: Annual net electricity from the wind project under typical resource and loss conditions.
families.formula: E_net = turbine_count * rated_capacity * hours_per_year * capacity_factor * net_loss_factor / 1000
families.external_back_check: Compare against an observed or modeled annual output for a held-out project class.
risks: capacity factor is site-specific
rated capacity cannot substitute for delivered output

families.title: Annual captured stormwater volume
families.template: For a supplied impervious catchment area and climate location, estimate the annual stormwater volume available for capture.
families.estimand: Annual runoff volume reaching a capture point under typical precipitation.
families.external_back_check: Compare with a documented rainwater or stormwater system in a similar climate.
risks: precipitation normals do not equal a future year
first-flush and overflow losses require explicit scope

families.title: Water mass contained in fresh snow
families.template: For a supplied covered area, fresh-snow depth, and climate class, estimate the liquid-water-equivalent mass of the snow.
families.estimand: Liquid-water-equivalent mass present immediately after the specified snowfall.
families.external_back_check: Compare with held-out SNOTEL or station snow-water-equivalent observations.
risks: snow density changes rapidly
wet and dry snow require distinct reference ranges

families.title: Annual commercial-building site energy
families.template: For a supplied commercial floor area, activity type, and climate division, estimate annual site energy use.
families.estimand: Annual site energy consumed by buildings of the specified activity type and climate division.
families.external_back_check: Compare the reconstructed aggregate against CBECS totals for a held-out building category.
risks: site and source energy must not be mixed
activity and climate strata may interact

families.title: Annual live births
families.template: For a supplied population and broad demographic context, estimate the number of live births in one year.
families.estimand: Registered live births occurring to the defined population during one calendar year.
families.external_back_check: Compare with held-out state or national registered-birth totals.
risks: fertility rate and crude birth rate are not interchangeable
local age structure can dominate

families.title: Occupied households and housing demand
families.template: For a supplied residential population and settlement context, estimate occupied households and total housing units required.
families.estimand: Occupied households and implied total housing units under a defined vacancy treatment.
families.external_back_check: Reconstruct and compare with held-out ACS housing-unit totals.
risks: households and housing units are different estimands
group quarters require explicit exclusion

families.title: Public K-12 enrollment
families.template: For a supplied population and demographic context, estimate fall public K-12 enrollment.
families.estimand: Students enrolled in public prekindergarten through grade 12 at the specified fall reference date.
families.external_back_check: Compare with a held-out NCES state enrollment total.
risks: age range and grade coverage must be frozen
private and homeschool students require explicit treatment

families.title: Annual commute trips
families.template: For a supplied working-age population and labor-market context, estimate annual one-way commute trips.
families.estimand: One-way journeys to or from a usual workplace during a defined year.
families.external_back_check: Compare with held-out ACS journey-to-work counts and FHWA travel aggregates.
risks: trips and person-miles are distinct
hybrid work makes annual frequency time-sensitive

families.title: Annual municipal solid waste generation
families.template: For a supplied service population and settlement context, estimate annual municipal solid waste generated before recovery.
families.estimand: Municipal solid waste generated before recycling, composting, or disposal during one year.
families.external_back_check: Compare with a held-out state or municipal waste characterization total.
risks: generated and discarded waste must not be conflated
commercial inclusion varies by jurisdiction

families.title: Annual data-center electricity
families.template: For a supplied installed IT power capacity and workload class, estimate annual facility electricity use.
families.estimand: Annual electricity drawn by IT equipment and supporting facility systems.
families.external_back_check: Compare reconstructed national or facility-class demand against DOE/LBNL aggregates.
risks: nameplate power is not average IT load
PUE scope and time averaging must be fixed

families.title: Annual electric-vehicle charging demand
families.template: For a supplied electric-vehicle fleet size and use context, estimate annual grid electricity required for charging.
families.estimand: Annual grid electricity delivered to support the fleet's vehicle travel.
families.external_back_check: Compare with held-out fleet telemetry or utility charging-sales totals.
risks: vehicle-side and grid-side energy differ
fleet use differs from household vehicle averages

families.title: Annual streetlight electricity
families.template: For a supplied road-network extent and lighting context, estimate annual streetlight electricity use.
families.estimand: Annual electricity consumed by roadway luminaires and controls in the specified network.
families.formula: E = road_length * luminaires_per_length * average_input_power * annual_operating_hours * control_factor / 1000
families.external_back_check: Compare with held-out municipal streetlight inventories and utility-billed consumption.
risks: fixture spacing depends on road class
networked dimming requires an explicit profile

families.title: Annual seawater reverse-osmosis electricity
families.template: For a supplied product-water capacity, seawater context, and operating schedule, estimate annual site electricity used by a reverse-osmosis desalination facility.
families.estimand: Annual site electricity used to produce finished water, including explicitly in-scope intake, pretreatment, reverse osmosis, energy recovery, and post-treatment systems.
families.external_back_check: Compare with a held-out facility's annual product-water output and site-electricity record.
risks: process-only and whole-site electricity must not be mixed
feed salinity, recovery ratio, and energy-recovery equipment materially affect energy intensity

families.title: Battery-pack mass for usable storage
families.template: For a supplied usable-energy requirement and application class, estimate total installed battery-pack mass.
families.estimand: Pack-level battery mass needed to deliver the specified usable energy at beginning of life.
families.external_back_check: Compare with held-out commercial pack specifications at similar energy and application class.
risks: cell and pack specific energy differ
power-to-energy ratio and thermal hardware affect mass

families.title: Annual food-at-home expenditure
families.template: For a supplied population and household context, estimate annual household food-at-home expenditure.
families.estimand: Annual expenditure by resident consumer units on food consumed at home, in a frozen price year.
families.external_back_check: Compare reconstructed national expenditure with a held-out BLS aggregate.
risks: consumer unit is not identical to household
nominal and real dollars must not be mixed

families.title: Annual food-services sales
families.template: For a supplied resident population and visitor context, estimate annual food-services and drinking-places sales.
families.estimand: Annual nominal sales of in-scope food-services and drinking-place establishments.
families.external_back_check: Compare with held-out Census food-services sales totals.
risks: NAICS scope must be frozen
tourism and commuter leakage can dominate local totals

families.title: Annual industry payroll
families.template: For a supplied employment count, industry, and region, estimate annual payroll before benefits.
families.estimand: Gross annual wages paid to in-scope employees, excluding employer benefit costs.
families.external_back_check: Compare with a held-out QCEW annual-pay total for a matched industry-region cell.
risks: wages and total compensation differ
part-time composition affects annual hours

families.title: Annual general sales-tax revenue
families.template: For a supplied consumer base and statutory context, estimate annual general sales-tax revenue.
families.estimand: Annual revenue from the defined general sales and use tax, excluding separately administered excises.
families.formula: revenue = consumer_units * annual_spend_per_unit * taxable_share * effective_tax_rate * compliance_factor
families.external_back_check: Compare with a held-out Census government-finance sales-tax total.
risks: statutory and effective rates differ
tax base exclusions are jurisdiction-specific

families.title: Annual residential-electricity expenditure
families.template: For a supplied residential-customer count and region, estimate annual residential-electricity expenditure.
families.estimand: Annual billed residential-electricity revenue for the specified customer base and year.
families.external_back_check: Reconstruct and compare with held-out EIA residential revenue totals.
risks: customer and household counts differ
retail price must match the specified year and region

families.title: Annual dairy-milk production
families.template: For a supplied milk-cow inventory and production context, estimate annual milk production.
families.estimand: Milk produced by the specified milk-cow inventory during one year.
families.external_back_check: Compare reconstructed production with a held-out USDA NASS state or national total.
risks: milk cows and all cattle are different populations
yield varies by production system

families.title: Annual table-egg production
families.template: For a supplied laying-hen inventory and production context, estimate annual table-egg production.
families.estimand: Table eggs produced by the specified laying flock during one year.
families.external_back_check: Compare with a held-out USDA NASS layer and egg-production aggregate.
risks: table eggs and hatching eggs require separate scope
average inventory and point-in-time inventory differ

families.title: Annual urban-tree carbon sequestration
families.template: For a supplied urban-tree inventory and broad composition context, estimate annual gross carbon sequestration.
families.estimand: Gross annual carbon added to live urban-tree biomass, before mortality and decomposition losses.
families.external_back_check: Compare with a held-out Urban FIA or i-Tree municipal estimate.
risks: gross sequestration is not net climate benefit
species, size, and condition drive wide variation

families.title: Annual companion-animal dry-food demand
families.template: For a supplied household count and pet context, estimate annual dry-food mass consumed by in-scope companion animals.
families.estimand: Annual as-fed dry-food mass consumed by the defined dog or cat population.
families.formula: food = household_count * ownership_rate * animals_per_owning_household * daily_food_per_animal * days_per_year * mass_conversion
families.external_back_check: Compare with held-out pet-food shipment or market-volume estimates without using them as primary evidence.
risks: energy requirement does not directly equal as-fed mass
animal size distribution and wet-food share matter

families.title: Annual domestic wastewater nitrogen load
families.template: For a supplied sewered population and service context, estimate annual domestic total-nitrogen load entering wastewater treatment.
families.estimand: Annual domestic total-nitrogen mass reaching the treatment-plant influent before removal.
families.formula: nitrogen = sewered_population * per_capita_nitrogen_load * days_per_year * collection_factor * mass_conversion
families.external_back_check: Compare with held-out treatment-plant influent flow and concentration totals.
risks: industrial nitrogen must be excluded
infiltration changes concentration but not domestic mass load in a simple way
